# Source2Lineage

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) before every task. It is the tool-neutral source
of truth for evidence, safety, schema, and workflow rules.

Use `/lineage-analyze` to inspect a codebase and create `data-lineage.yaml` plus
`system-analysis.md`. Use `/lineage-validate` to check an existing pair.
